blocks.html: Watch and listen to the stirring sounds of string quartet performances at The Garden, Robinsons Magnolia on March 20 and 27 at 3 pm.
Enjoy the stirring sounds of string quartet performances at The Garden, Robinsons Magnolia.
Enjoy your meals, ala al fresco as you listen to their renditions of Classical Standards, Broadway, Pop songs, OPM to Kundiman, creating an ambiance that will surely make you feel relaxed.

You can also have a weekend date with your fur babies, let them play around The Garden and be truly surrounded by warm and fuzzy vibes, or just let yourself get lost in the music with your loved ones.

To see the complete line-up of upcoming performances, events & promos, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or its Virtual Directory bit.ly/RMallsVirtualMallDirectory; or follow Robinsons Magnolia on Facebook; @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram; and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter.
